check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点打卡，连续打卡满 7 天解锁新场景。

dialogue.en: This place is packed today. Have you tried their ramen before?
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 今天这家人好多。你吃过他们家的拉面吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 简短反问是最省力的接话方式

dialogue.en: So good. The broth is amazing. You should get it.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 特别好吃，汤头很棒。你应该试试。

dialogue.en: Sold. Ramen it is. So, Alex, how's the new apartment?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: Sold 是接受推荐的地道说法；抛话题给 Alex 时用 So + 名字
dialogue.zh: 好，就它了，拉面。对了 Alex，新公寓怎么样？

dialogue.en: Still boxes everywhere, honestly. But the kitchen's finally usable.
dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.zh: 说实话，箱子还堆得到处都是。不过厨房总算能用了。

dialogue.en: Ha, the kitchen first — priorities in the right order.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 用幽默 acknowledge 对方的话，比只说 nice 更拉近距离
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，先搞定厨房——优先级排得对。

dialogue.en: Exactly. Hey, Maya mentioned you're doing the Storm migration. That sounds intense.
dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.zh: 没错。哎，Maya 说你在做 Storm 迁移，听起来挺有挑战的。

dialogue.en: It is, honestly. Lots of moving parts. But the team's been great — everyone's jumping in to help.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: honestly 让语气真诚；moving parts 指事情的多个环节
dialogue.zh: 说实话是的，涉及的环节很多。不过团队很给力——大家都很帮忙。

dialogue.en: That's the best part of this team, honestly.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 说实话，这就是这个团队最棒的地方。

dialogue.en: Totally agree. Oh — Alex, did you end up going hiking last weekend?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 用之前聊过的事做 follow-up，对方会觉得你真的在听
dialogue.zh: 完全同意。哦对了——Alex，你上周末去爬山了吗？

dialogue.en: I did! Rattlesnake Lake. The view was unreal.
dialogue.speaker: Alex

dialogue.en: No way, I've been meaning to go there. Was the trail crowded?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: No way 在这里表示惊喜，不是字面的不可能；顺势追问让对话延续
dialogue.zh: 真的吗，我一直想去。人多吗？

key_phrases.note: 接受别人推荐时的地道说法，比 OK 更生动

key_phrases.en: Ha, the kitchen first — priorities in the right order.
key_phrases.note: 用幽默 acknowledge 对方，比 nice 走心
key_phrases.zh: 哈哈，先搞定厨房——优先级排得对。

key_phrases.note: 承认有挑战，honestly 让语气真诚不端着

key_phrases.en: That's the best part of this team.
key_phrases.note: 夸团队，适合新人融入、拉近距离
key_phrases.zh: 这就是这个团队最棒的地方。

key_phrases.en: Did you end up going hiking?
key_phrases.note: follow-up 对方之前提过的事，证明你在听

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS 逐句跟读，重点练 Sold. Ramen it is. 的干脆语气
替换练习 5 分钟：把 ramen / apartment / hiking 换成你自己的真实话题，大声说 3 遍
多人模拟 5 分钟：一人分饰两角，练习在 Maya 和 Alex 之间抛话题、接话
roleplay_zh: 假设你和两位同事吃午饭。用英文聊 3 分钟：接受一个推荐、用幽默 acknowledge 一个人、follow-up 一个人上周提过的事。
scene_zh: 和 Maya、Alex 一起吃午饭的多人闲聊。目标是轻松聊天、了解同事，练习在多人对话里接话、抛话题、用幽默回应。
title: Lunch Small Talk
